dct_description_sm: Guide defines Prime Farmland, Unique Farmland, Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance, Additional Farmland of Local Importance and lists the soil mapping units for Prime Farmland and Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance.

April 1980.; Shows "prime farmland", "additional farmland of statewide importance", "additional land that qualifies as agricultural capability class IV", and "other land."; "Interpretations derived from soil map constructed in 1950 by Cartographic Division, Soil Conservation Service, USDA, of Carbon Co., Pa."; Base map: USGS 1:24,000 scale maps.; Includes location map and note.
1 map :color ;91 x 90 cm + guide (6 unnumbered pages ; 28 cm).
